From Wiktionary, the free dictionary
See also: balanca, balançà, and Balança

Catalan

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): (Central, Balearic) [bəˈlan.sə]
  • IPA(key): (Valencia) [baˈlan.sa]
  • Audio (Barcelona):(file)
  • Rhymes: -ansa

Etymology 1

[edit]

Inherited from Late Latin *bilancia, from Latin bilanx, from bi- (see Latin bis) and lanx.

Noun

[edit]

balança f (plural balances)

  1. balance
  2. scales
  3. Libra (Zodiac sign)
Derived terms
[edit]
  • balanç
  • balançada
  • balançar
  • balancejar
  • balancer
  • balancera
  • balançó

Etymology 2

[edit]

See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.

Verb

[edit]

balança

  1. inflection of balançar:
    1. third-person singular present indicative
    2. second-person singular imperative

Further reading

[edit]
  • “balança”, in Diccionari de la llengua catalana [Dictionary of the Catalan Language] (in Catalan), second edition, Institute of Catalan Studies [Catalan: Institut d'Estudis Catalans], April 2007
  • “balança”, in Gran Diccionari de la Llengua Catalana, Grup Enciclopèdia Catalana, 2026
  • “balança” in Diccionari normatiu valencià, Acadèmia Valenciana de la Llengua.
  • “balança” in Diccionari català-valencià-balear, Antoni Maria Alcover and Francesc de Borja Moll, 1962.

balança
Wikipedia pt

Inherited from Late Latin *bilancia, from Latin bilanx, from bi- (see Latin bis) and lanx.

Noun

[edit]

balança f (plural balanças)

  1. balance
  2. scales (device for weighing goods for sale)
